name: Tech Lead
description: Leads engineering delivery across the Technology & Engineering value stream, setting deployment standards and steering infrastructure-as-code, environment lifecycle, and CI/CD practices. Governs secrets management and certificate lifecycles, defining rotation policies and retiring deprecated IaC modules. Reports cloud posture and drift trends to governance and drives post-deployment lessons learned.

name: Territory Manager
description: Oversees broker distribution across an assigned territory within the Sales, Distribution & Marketing value stream. Manages agency and broker relationship governance, producer training, and producer termination controls, certifying producer compliance records and licensing agreements. Supports renewal retention and digital channel performance, validating MGA bordereaux and resolving cross-functional channel conflicts.

name: Test Lead
description: Leads quality assurance and control testing spanning Risk, Compliance & Audit, HR, and Data & AI work. Tests control design and operating effectiveness, assesses control coverage, and supports market conduct examinations by drafting and validating responses to examiner findings. Coordinates pay equity analyses and corrective-action tracking through remediation closure.

name: Third-Party Risk Manager
description: Manages vendor and operational resilience risk within the Risk, Compliance & Audit value stream. Runs BCM programme governance and testing, scheduling exercises across critical services, documenting results, and raising remediation actions. Maintains business impact analyses, important business service definitions, and IT disaster recovery plans, and coordinates incident response and crisis communications governance.

name: Threat Detection Engineer
description: Performs detection engineering and threat intelligence operations within Cybersecurity & IAM. Builds and tunes detection rules and SOAR playbooks, testing in sandbox and promoting via change control, and triages and prioritizes confirmed alerts before escalating to incident response. Investigates threats, pivots on indicators to scope compromise, and publishes threat intelligence advisories.

name: Trader
description: Executes trades and portfolio rebalancing within the Finance & Investments value stream, obtaining authorization and issuing orders to the execution desk. Supports security selection, trade settlement, and portfolio valuation, sourcing and validating end-of-period prices. Monitors investment guideline compliance, tracks breach remediation, and documents rebalancing rationale in line with investment policy.

name: Trainer
description: Delivers enterprise learning across the Human Resources & Talent value stream, developing learning content and refining curricula from feedback. Administers mandatory training compliance, licensing, and certification tracking, including director continuing-education completion. Supports leadership development programs and coaching, designs annual awareness training, and evaluates program impact against leadership KPIs.

name: Treasury Analyst
description: Performs daily cash positioning, reconciliation, and payment execution within the Finance & Investments value stream. Investigates unreconciled cash breaks and rejected payments, screens outbound payments against sanctions lists, and applies dual-authorization release controls. Runs liquidity stress testing, defining scenarios and shock assumptions and reporting results to ALCO and finance leadership.

name: Treasury Manager
description: Owns tax compliance and planning within the Finance & Investments value stream, filing income, premium, and payroll tax returns by statutory deadlines. Administers 1099-R tax reporting end to end, from recipient statements through IRS transmission and record retention. Manages tax provision, controversy matters, and reconciliation of tax payments to general ledger accruals.

name: Treaty Specialist
description: Administers treaty operations across the Reinsurance value stream, from assumed quoting and individual risk pricing to line authorization and collateral management. Structures retrocession and alternative-capital arrangements, documenting recommendations for management approval. Manages premium settlement and loss notifications, reconciling reinsurer balances, preparing cash calls, and producing the ceded reinsurance close package.

name: UI Developer
description: Builds and maintains digital solutions within Technology & Engineering, supporting solution build, developer experience enablement, and backlog prioritization. Sustains digital channel operations for distribution, handling escalated sessions and reconciling producer onboarding handoffs. Contributes to engineering knowledge management and governance policy standards, retiring stale articles and monitoring policy acknowledgment completion.

name: UW Operations Manager
description: Oversees underwriting operations and governance within the Underwriting value stream, managing policy binding, mid-term endorsement processing, and quote revision with brokers. Administers the reinsurance program, screening treaties for retention and submitting bordereaux to treaty reinsurers. Maintains appetite guidelines and exception tracking, and drives underwriting quality assurance including post-training QA score improvement.

name: UX Designer
description: Coordinates delivery readiness within the Product & Delivery value stream, planning releases, drafting release notes, and distributing stakeholder communications. Supports business acceptance testing coordination and tracks readiness completion with weekly status reporting. Champions the agile delivery framework and continuous improvement, coaching product owners and squads and following through on retrospective actions.
